For Respondents : Mr.S.Gopinathan,
 Standing counsel, for R1 and R3

Mr.Tippusulthan,
 Government Advocate, for R2

Mr.N.R.R.Arun Natarajan,
 SGP, for R4  ORDER Writ petition is filed for a writ of mandamus, directing the respondents to renew the license of the petitioner without insisting on No Objection Certificate from the Temple Authority, 4th respondent herein.

2. When the matter is came up for hearing before this court, the learned counsel for the 3rd respondent submitted that the petitioner is a encroacher and that proceedings under Section 78 of the HR & CE Act, were invoked for eviction of the petitioner.
The learned counsel on instructions submits that orders in proceedings under Section 78 of the Act were passed on 18.06.2025, for eviction of the petitioner and the subtenant, one Saraswathi.

3. In view of the fact that the eviction order is already passed by the 2 nd respondent, against the petitioner under Section 78 of the Tamil Nadu Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Act,
1959

The writ petition is accordingly disposed of.
